tagline: Self-hosted caregiver coordination: your data stays with you.

login.noAccount: I don't have an account, sign up
login.haveAccount: I already have an account, sign in

invite.invalid: Invalid or expired invitation. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.

forgot.subtitle: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. Depending on how your instance is configured, you will receive an email, or an admin of your circle will hand you a link.
forgot.sentEmail: If an account exists with this address, an email with a reset link has just been sent. The link is valid for one hour.
forgot.sentAdmin: This instance does not send emails. If an account exists with this address, the admins of your circle have been notified: they will find a reset link on their Circle page to hand to you. The link is valid for one hour.

reset.subtitle: New password
reset.tooShort: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.done: You can now sign in with your new password. Other open sessions have been signed out.
reset.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Links are valid for one hour and can only be used once.
